gascityCockpit.worktreeLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Annotate files with the in-flight beads/polecats whose worktrees are editing them right now (a CodeLens at the top of the file plus an Explorer badge). Turn off to silence the lens.

gascityCockpit.worktreeLens.refreshInter.markdownDescription: How often (seconds) to re-scan the fleet's worktrees for the code lens. Each scan runs read-only `git diff` in every in-progress bead's worktree; lower values are fresher but busier.
